get.description: Retrieves an item from Hacker News.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

descendants.description: Total comment count for stories or polls.

kids.description: Child comment IDs in ranked order.

parts.description: Poll option item IDs for polls.

poll.description: Associated poll ID for poll options.

score.description: Story score or poll option votes.

text.description: HTML body for comments, stories, or polls.

time.description: Unix timestamp when the item was created.

title.description: Title for stories, polls, or jobs.

type.description: Item type: job, story, comment, poll, or pollopt.
